{{nihongo|'''Saki Shrine'''|佐紀神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Saki Shrine''' (さきじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Kamehata, aza Saki-chō, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Saki-chō}}, {{ill|Nara (city)|Q169134|qid=Q169134}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=small Shikinaisha}}, former {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=village shrine}} under old shrine ranking, and a {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=shrine designated for sacred food/silk offerings}}{{sfn|奈良県史|p=28}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* {{ill|Futsunushi|lt=Futsunushi-no-Kami|Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|lt=Futsunushi-no-Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}
* Six Mikata Deities - regarded as deities seated in six mikata of Takachi, Katsuraki, Tōchi, Shiki, Yamabe, and Sofu{{sfn|奈良市史|p=304}}.

=== Precinct ===
[[File:Saki Shrine (Nara, Kamehata) Haiden.jpg|thumb|200px|Haiden]]
=== Honden ===
Ikken-sha {{ill|Nagare-zukuri|Q210684|qid=Q210684}}, with three associated seats{{sfn|奈良市史|p=305}}. Beside it is a foundation stone carved with round seat, considered from Chōshō-ji{{sfn|奈良市史|p=305}}.

=== Haiden ===
Two-ken four-sided, tiled roof{{sfn|奈良市史|p=305}}.

=== Precinct shrines ===
[[File:Saki Shrine (Nara, Kamehata) Keidaisha1.jpg|thumb|200px|Benzaiten small shrine]]
* {{ill|Benzaiten|lt=Benzaiten|Q818468|qid=Q818468|qid=Q818468|lt=Benzaiten}} small shrine - south-facing before torii, enshrines three Benzaiten deities{{sfn|奈良市史|p=305}}. In front is stone lantern from {{ill|Meireki|Q1192766|qid=Q1192766}} 2 ({{ill|1656|Q6982|qid=Q6982}}){{sfn|奈良市史|p=305}}.
* Massha {{ill|Ichikishima-hime|Q11059454|qid=Q11059454|lt=Ichikishima-hime}} Shrine, {{ill|Ōkuninushi|Q276944|qid=Q276944}} Shrine - east of honden{{sfn|奈良市史|p=305}}.
* {{ill|Haraedo no Kami|Q11588504|qid=Q11588504|lt=Haraedo-sha}}

=== Treasures ===
Treasures related to Chōshō-ji are preserved and all deposited at {{ill|Nara National Museum|Q147312|qid=Q147312}}{{sfn|奈良市史|p=306}}<ref name="yuisho" />.
* Pair of yosegi-wood painted Komainu
* One green staff said to have been secretly treasured by {{ill|Tokugawa Ieyasu|Q171977|qid=Q171977|lt=Ieyasu}}
* One hanging scroll, paper, colored {{ill|Marici (Buddhism)|Q3273446|qid=Q3273446}} image
* One hanging scroll, silk, colored {{ill|Sūryaprabha|Q2661877|qid=Q2661877}} two divine generals image
* One hanging scroll, silk, colored {{ill|Candraprabha|Q2671293|qid=Q2671293}} {{ill|Twelve Heavenly Generals|Q842329|qid=Q842329}} image
* One hanging scroll, silk, colored {{ill|Jūniten|Q9503981|qid=Q9503981}} image
* One hanging scroll, paper, colored {{ill|Kasuga-taisha|Q714559|qid=Q714559|lt=Akadōji}} image
* One scroll, dark-blue paper with {{ill|Gold paint-Gindei|Q11647560|qid=Q11647560|lt=gold mud}} {{ill|Lotus Sutra|Q861212|qid=Q861212}} Fumon chapter
